responsibility: This file implements the playback phase that turns libgccjit’s recorded API objects into real GCC trees, declarations, blocks, and source locations for compilation. It provides playback::context logic for replaying a recording context, mapping public JIT types to tree nodes, handling conversions and tree construction, maintaining the active_playback_ctxt singleton used by the dummy frontend and GC, forwarding GCC diagnostics back to recording errors, and building linemap-backed source_file/source_line/location objects so generated trees carry source coordinates. In short, it is the core lowering layer from the persistent recording IR into GCC’s in-memory frontend and middle-end representation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-playback.h, which declares playback::context and its wrapper classes, this same-stem .c file performs the actual replay of recorded JIT state into GCC internals, including tree construction, source-location/linemap materialization, diagnostic forwarding, and management of the active playback context used during compilation.
